latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Longbridge Developers skill.

- Provides comprehensive support for Longbridge CLI, Python/Rust SDKs, MCP server, and LLM integration.
- Handles stock/market analysis, live data retrieval, news/catalyst aggregation, and portfolio queries for HK, US, CN, SG, and Crypto markets.
- Includes workflow guidance for investment analysis and developer tasks with tool selection recommendations.
- Offers symbol format reference and links to detailed documentation for CLI and SDK usage.
- Enables integration with AI agents and LLMs using official docs and reference files.
